date.as_written: vedāś ca saptayo sapta indū śākaś ca bhādrayoḥ śukla daśamyāṃ cāndre ca

notes: Chronogram vedāḥ (4) saptayo (7) sapta (7) indū (1), read right to left = Śāka 1774 (1852 CE). Bhādrapada śukla 10 falls around 23–24 Aug 1852 by rough calculation, which fits Monday (cāndre). The catalogue's second date, ŚS 1713, has no support in the quoted colophon and may be a cataloguer error. 'hanumate' is a dative in form. It is most likely a garbled agent ('written by Hanumat'), which the catalogue reads as Hanumāna (!), but it could also be a dedication or beneficiary ('written for Hanumat/Hanumān'). Place 'rāmaghāṭa': possibly Rām Ghāṭ in Vārāṇasī, but this is not certain.
